text: The airline began service with Saunders ST-27 aircraft.

text: By 1976, the airline had expanded its network to smaller regional destinations.

text: The first international charter flights began to Havana, Varadero, Nassau, Freeport, Montego Bay, Puerto Plata, Punta Cana, St. Kitts, St. Maarten, Porlamar and Cancun.

text: ACES merged with Avianca and SAM to form the Alianza Summa.

subject: self
text: ACES operations were halted after the boards decision to liquidate the airline.

text: ACES ceased operations after liquidating.

text: A DHC-6 Twin Otter (registered HK-2216) crashed in the municipality of San Antero during the approach to the Coveñas Airport, and 13 people perished.

subject: self
text: A DHC-6 Twin Otter (registered HK-2536) crashed in the foothills of the Eastern Cordillera against Cerro Pan de Azúcar, and 20 passengers and the crew lost their lives.
quote: On November 29 , 1982 , a DHC-6 Twin Otter ( registered HK-2536 ) crashed in the foothills of the Eastern Cordillera against Cerro Pan de Azúcar

subject: self
text: A DHC-6 Twin Otter (registered HK-2445) was hijacked and the pilot was demanded to land at an abandoned airstrip in Colombia.
quote: On August 1 , 1988 , a DHC-6 Twin Otter ( registered HK-2445 ) was hijacked

subject: self
text: A DHC-6 Twin Otter operating flight 148 (registered HK-2602) crashed into Cerro El Barcino a few minutes after takeoff from Olaya Herrera Airport, and 14 people died.
quote: On November 30 , 1996 , a DHC-6 Twin Otter , operating flight 148 , ( registered HK-2602 ) crashed into Cerro El Barcino

subject: self
text: An ATR 42-500 (registered VP-BOF) and a Boeing 727-200 (registered HK-3998X) collided on the El Dorado International Airport apron during the towing process, and the ATR 42-500 was declared a total loss.
